title: VISA: Value Injection via Shielded Adaptation for Personalized LLM Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning LLMs with human value systems using the Schwartz Theory of Basic Values. It specifically benchmarks and evaluates dimensions such as Tradition (which explicitly includes religious importance), Benevolence, and Universalism. The methodology utilizes the Inglehart-Welzel axes to measure Traditional vs. Secular-Rational values, which is a core study of societal morals and ethics.
